why: removes 2 mixin injection handler(s): check each still applies somewhere, with the same effect
reviewed: Each removed handler is re-done on 1.21.11's frame graph with 1.21.1's effect, not only moved. renderClouds HEAD: 1.21.11 has no DimensionSpecialEffects; lambda$addCloudsPass$3 evaluates customCloudsRenderer == null || !customCloudsRenderer.renderClouds(...) before CloudRenderer.render, so the overlay cancels that lambda at its HEAD (require = 1) -- an injection at the renderClouds call would miss every dimension without a custom renderer -- and a dimension drawing its own clouds is skipped too; CloudRendererMixin still gates CloudRenderer.render. renderSky TAIL: AfterSky is posted only inside the sky pass, which renderLevel omits when its render-sky flag is false (GameRenderer passes !bossOverlay.shouldCreateWorldFog(); isFoggyAt no longer exists) and addSkyPass omits for Skybox NONE, lava/powder snow or blindness/darkness, and it is posted even after CustomSkyboxRenderer.renderSky returned true; so the overlay adds an eca_global_skybox pass on targets.main just before addMainPass, sets renderLevel's world fog buffer (FogRenderer.getBuffer(WORLD)) with RenderSystem.setShaderFog as the sky pass does, skips it when lambda$addSkyPass$8's CustomSkyboxRenderer.renderSky returned true (eca$recordCustomSky, require = 1) and, on a frame with no sky pass (render-sky flag false for boss world fog, Skybox NONE, lava/powder snow, blindness/darkness, where 1.21.11 never calls renderSky but 1.21.1 still asked it before the TAIL), when levelRenderState.customSkyboxRenderer is non-null (renderLevel fills it before adding the sky and main passes, per javap of neoforge-21.11.45-merged.jar), and sets GlobalSkyboxHook.passOwned so the AfterSky handler stands down. The PoseStack starts from identity because renderLevel still multiplies the view matrix onto the model-view stack and LegacyGl/RenderType.draw upload getModelViewMatrix() as ModelViewMat (the earlier 1.21.11 handler multiplied AfterSky's model-view matrix, that same view matrix, a second time). The renderEntity HEAD/RETURN bracket is the extractVisibleEntities frustum capture plus the @Redirect of EntityRenderDispatcher.submit in submitEntities. Its cloud-occlusion mark is per frame and read later by the clouds pass, so marking at submit is the same effect. Its fog effect (1.21.1 pushed fog start/end to MAX_VALUE around renderEntity) is not a flag on 1.21.11: the world fog slice is written in setupFog before the frame and bound when renderAllFeatures draws, so (ECA-026, port of 1.21.10's fix) a force-loaded entity with no fluid in the camera is submitted into the mixin's own FeatureRenderDispatcher (the 7-argument constructor, own SubmitNodeStorage) and drawn at once inside the main pass with FogRenderer.getBuffer(FogMode.NONE) set by RenderSystem.setShaderFog, the previous slice restored after (GameRenderer.fogRenderer opened by the access transformer); its outline still goes to the outline buffer source vanilla flushes later.
